title: Kaera language
description: Trans–New Guinea language spoken in Indonesia
extract: Kaera is a Papuan language spoken on the northeastern coast of Pantar Island in the Alor Archipelago of Indonesia. It belongs to the Timor-Alor-Pantar language family. Kaera is used alongside Indonesian in religious contexts, but not used in education.
